title: The Crypt Below the Altar
intro: Stone steps lead down into cold air that smells of earth. Coffins line the walls. One sarcophagus has a lock instead of a lid.

objects.label: Iron Gate
objects.reward_text: The gate rattles. A number is hammered into the rusted bars: 3.

objects.label: Open Coffin
objects.reward_text: The coffin is not empty. It never was.

a_pile: Try assuming the first speaker is a knight and follow what that forces. If you hit a contradiction, they are a knave.
A statement from a knave must be FALSE. Negate it to learn something certain.
The knights are Aldric, Hester. The code is AH. The vault's character number 1 is F.
b_gate: This is a quick quiz of five reasoning questions. Read each one calmly.
You need 3 of the 5 right. The server keeps the clock, so do not dawdle.
If you fail you can try again with a fresh set of questions.
Answer the five questions and the reward shows a clue number. The vault's character number 2 is G.
c_angel: Look up P and Q in your clue notes.
List the numbers above 56 that leave remainder 2 when divided by P.
Check each of them against the second condition (remainder 1 when divided by Q).
The answer is 58. The vault's characters number 3 and 4 are 6 and N.
vault: The code has four characters. Some are letters, some are digits.
Each solved object revealed part of the code. Check the vault display.
The pieces go in the order they sit on the vault: Bone Pile, Iron Gate, Stone Angel.
